}\n415\t\n416\t    /// Run cargo test with the given additional arguments.\n417\t    ///\n418\t    /// ## Arguments\n419\t    ///\n420\t    /// * `args` - Additional arguments to pass to cargo test\n421\t    ///\n422\t    /// ## Returns\n423\t    ///\n424\t    /// Returns `TestResult` containing:\n425\t    /// - `status`: The test execution status (Success, Failed, CompilationFailed, fn run_tests(&self, args: &[&str]) -> Result<TestResult> {\n436\t        let start = Instant::now();\n437\t\n438\t        // Build the command\n439\t        let mut cmd = Command::new(\"cargo\");\n440\t        cmd.arg(\"test\");\n441\t        cmd.current_dir(&self.workspace);\n442\t        cmd.stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped());\n443\t        cmd.stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped());\n444\t\n445\t        // Add extra arguments\n446\t        for arg in &self.extra_args {\n447\t            cmd.arg(arg);\n448\t        }\n449\t\n450\t        // Add additional arguments\n451\t        for arg in args {\n452\t            cmd.arg(arg);\n453\t        }\n454\t\n455\t        // Spawn the process\n456\t        tracing::debug!(\n457\t            workspace = %self.workspace.display(),\n458\t            args = ?args,\n459\t            \"spawning cargo test process\"\n460\t        );\n461\t\n462\t        let result = self.execute_with_timeout(cmd)?;\n463\t\n464\t        let duration = start.elapsed();\n465\t\n466\t        // Build the test result with captured output\n467\t        let test_result = match result {\n468\t            Some(output) => TestResult::from_output(output, duration),\n469\t            None => TestResult::timeout(duration),\n470\t        };\n471\t\n472\t        tracing::info!(\n473\t protection.\n484\t    ///\n485\t    /// Returns Ok(Some(output)) if the command completes within timeout,\n486\t    /// Ok(None) if the command times out, or Err if the process fails to spawn.\n487\t    fn execute_with_timeout(&self, mut cmd: Command) -> Result<Option<Output>> {\n488\t        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.timeout_secs);\n489\t\n490\t        // Spawn the process\n491\t        let mut child = cmd.spawn().context(\"failed to spawn cargo test process\")?;\n492\t\n493\t        // Wait for completion with timeout\n494\t        let start = Instant::now();\n495\t        loop {\n496\t            // Check if timeout exceeded\n497\t            if start.elapsed() > timeout {\n498\t                tracing::error!(timeout_secs = self.timeout_secs, \"cargo test timed out\");\n499\t\n500\t                // Kill the child process\n501\t                let _ = child.kill();\n502\t                let _ = child.wait();\n503\t\n504\t                return Ok(None);\n505\t            }\n506\t\n507\t            // Try to wait with a small timeout\n508\t            match child.try_wait() {\n509\t                Ok(Some(_status)) => {\n510\t                    // Process has exited\n511\t                    return Ok(Some(child.wait_with_output()?));\n512\t                }\n513\t                Ok(None) => {\n514\t                    // Still running, sleep a bit and retry\n515\t                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n516\t                }\n517\t                Err(e) => {\n518\t                    return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"error waiting for cargo test: {}\", e))\n519\t                        .context(\"failed to wait for cargo test process\");\n520\t                }\n521\t            }\n522\t        }\n523\t    }\n524\t\n525\t    /// Get the workspace directory.\n526\t    pub fn workspace(&self) -> &Path {\n527\t        &self.workspace\n528\t    }\n529\t\n530\t    /// Get the timeout in
